selection_rule: Rank by case-volume Dice, then all-slice mean Dice, then lower negative false-positive mask rate.
reason: Both V1a.4 recovery families improved validation presence recall, but neither improved the predeclared primary Stage-2 MedSAM ranking metric. The frozen V1a.3-B B1 baseline retains the best validation case-volume Dice (0.8547517823). R2b raises presence recall to 0.9618604651 at unchanged FPR but reduces case-volume Dice to 0.8539345306 because recovered remote slices have poor frozen box/MedSAM quality.

development_stop.next_question: Presence recovery alone is insufficient when box geometry on recovered remote slices is unreliable. Future development should address geometry/prompt quality for low-confidence or remotely recovered slices rather than further widening case-level presence post-processing.
